movements.name: DB Bench Press
cues: Pin your shoulder blades back and down on the bench
Lower the dumbbells to mid-chest with elbows about 45 degrees out
Press up and slightly in until your arms are straight

movements.name: 1-Arm DB Row

harder_variation.name: Unsupported 1-Arm DB Row
harder_variation.how: Row from a split-stance hinge with no hand on the bench, so your trunk has to resist the twist

cues: Keep your back flat and close to parallel with the floor
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, not your armpit
Let the arm hang straight at the bottom of each rep

movements.name: Goblet Squat

harder_variation.name: Double DB Front Squat
harder_variation.how: Rack both dumbbells on your shoulders with elbows high and squat to the same depth

cues: Hold the dumbbell upright against your chest
Sit down between your heels with your chest up
Push your knees out in line with your toes

movements.name: RDL-to-Row

harder_variation.name: Single-Leg RDL-to-Row
harder_variation.how: Hinge on one leg with a dumbbell in the opposite hand, row once at the bottom, then stand; switch legs halfway through the set

cues: Push your hips back until the dumbbells pass your knees
Row both dumbbells to your ribs while you hold the hinge
Lower the dumbbells, then drive your hips forward to stand

movements.name: T-Push-Up
cues: Do a full push-up with your body in one straight line
At the top, rotate onto one hand and reach the other arm to the ceiling
Alternate sides each rep

movements.name: Curl-to-Press
cues: Curl both dumbbells to your shoulders with elbows close
Turn your palms forward and press straight overhead
Brace your abs so your lower back does not arch

movements.name: Skull Crusher
cues: Lie on the bench with the dumbbells above your shoulders
Bend only at the elbows to bring the dumbbells beside your head
Keep your upper arms still as you straighten

movements.name: Lateral Raise
cues: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height
Lead with your elbows, slightly bent
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears

movements.name: Plank
cues: Set your elbows under your shoulders
Squeeze your glutes and keep your hips level with your shoulders
Breathe steadily without letting your lower back sag

movements.name: DB Deadlift from floor

harder_variation.name: Deficit DB Deadlift
harder_variation.how: Stand on a 2-inch step or plate so the dumbbells start lower than your feet, then pull as usual

cues: Set the dumbbells beside your feet and hinge down with a flat back
Push the floor away and stand tall
Keep the dumbbells close to your legs the whole way

movements.name: Decline Push-Up
cues: Put your feet on the bench and your hands on the floor, just wider than your shoulders
Keep a straight line from heels to head
Lower until your chest is close to the floor, then push up

movements.name: Renegade Row
cues: Hold a plank on the dumbbells with your feet wide
Row one dumbbell to your hip without twisting your hips
Alternate sides each rep

movements.name: DB Thruster
cues: Hold the dumbbells at your shoulders and squat to full depth
Drive up and use that momentum to press overhead
Bring the dumbbells back to your shoulders as you start the next squat

movements.name: Front-Rack Reverse Lunge

harder_variation.name: Deficit Front-Rack Reverse Lunge
harder_variation.how: Stand on a 2-inch step or plate and step back off it so the back knee travels lower

cues: Rest the dumbbells on your shoulders with elbows forward
Step back and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor
Push through the front heel to return to standing

movements.name: Dead Bug
cues: Press your lower back into the floor for the whole set
Reach the opposite arm and leg out at the same time
Exhale as you extend, then return and switch sides

movements.name: DB Curl
cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides
Curl with palms up until the dumbbells reach your shoulders
Lower until your arms are fully straight

movements.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
cues: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands under the top plate
Lower it behind your head by bending only at the elbows
Keep your elbows pointed forward and your ribs down

movements.name: Side Plank
cues: Stack your elbow under your shoulder
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line
Hold for the target time, then switch sides

movements.name: Chest-Supported Row
cues: Lie chest down on the incline bench with your feet planted
Row both dumbbells until your elbows pass your ribs
Let your arms hang straight between reps

movements.name: Incline DB Bench

harder_variation.name: Single-Arm Incline DB Bench Press
harder_variation.how: Press one dumbbell at a time on the incline with the free hand on your hip, keeping your shoulders square

cues: Set the bench to a low incline and keep your shoulder blades back
Lower the dumbbells to your upper chest
Press up until your arms are straight over your shoulders

movements.name: DB Pullover

harder_variation.name: Cross-Bench DB Pullover
harder_variation.how: Lie across the bench with only your upper back on it and your hips low, which lengthens the stretch at the bottom

cues: Hold one dumbbell with both hands over your chest, elbows soft
Lower it behind your head until you feel your lats stretch
Pull it back over your chest without bending your elbows more

movements.name: Single-Leg RDL
cues: Stand on one leg with a soft knee
Hinge forward as the free leg reaches back, keeping your hips square
Stand tall by squeezing the glute of the standing leg

movements.name: Front-Rack Step-Up
cues: Rest the dumbbells on your shoulders with elbows forward
Put your whole foot on the bench and drive through that heel
Step down and finish all reps on one leg before switching

movements.name: Hammer Curl
cues: Hold the dumbbells with palms facing each other
Keep your elbows at your sides as you curl
Straighten your arms fully at the bottom

movements.name: Rear-Delt Fly
cues: Hinge forward until your torso is close to parallel with the floor
Raise the dumbbells out wide with a slight bend in the elbows
Keep your neck long and your shoulders away from your ears

movements.name: DB Fly
cues: Lie on the bench with the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing
Open your arms wide with a slight elbow bend until your chest stretches
Bring the dumbbells back together along the same arc

movements.name: Hollow Hold
cues: Press your lower back into the floor
Lift your shoulders and legs a few inches off the floor
Bend your knees if your lower back starts to lift

movements.name: Single-Arm DB Bench Press

harder_variation.name: Off-Bench Single-Arm DB Press
harder_variation.how: Slide over so only the non-working shoulder blade is on the bench, then press while bracing to stay level

cues: Hold the bench edge or your hip with the free hand
Brace your abs so your torso does not roll toward the dumbbell
Lower to chest level and press straight up

movements.name: Gorilla Row

harder_variation.name: Deficit Gorilla Row
harder_variation.how: Stand on a 2-inch step or plate so each row starts lower and travels farther

cues: Stand wide with both dumbbells on the floor between your feet
Hinge with a flat back and your knees bent
Row one dumbbell to your hip, then alternate sides

movements.name: Bulgarian Split Squat

harder_variation.name: Front-Foot-Elevated Bulgarian Split Squat
harder_variation.how: Stand the front foot on a 2-inch step or plate so you sink deeper on each rep

cues: Rest the top of your back foot on the bench
Drop the back knee straight down toward the floor
Drive through the front heel to stand

movements.name: B-Stance RDL
cues: Set the back toes beside the front heel for balance only
Keep most of your weight on the front leg
Hinge back with a flat back until the front hamstring stretches

movements.name: Spiderman Push-Up
cues: Bring one knee toward the same elbow as you lower
Keep your hips level with your shoulders
Alternate sides each rep

movements.name: Zottman Curl
cues: Curl up with your palms facing up
Turn your palms down at the top
Lower with palms down, then turn them up again at the bottom

movements.name: Tricep Kickback
cues: Hinge forward and pin your upper arms to your sides
Straighten your elbows until your arms point back
Keep your upper arms still for the whole set

movements.name: Russian Twist

harder_variation.name: Feet-Up Russian Twist
harder_variation.how: Lift your feet off the floor and keep them up for the whole set

cues: Sit tall and lean back until your abs switch on
Rotate your shoulders to bring the dumbbell beside each hip
Count each side as one rep

movements.name: DB Sumo Deadlift

harder_variation.name: Deficit DB Sumo Deadlift
harder_variation.how: Stand with each foot on a 2-inch step or plate so the dumbbells start below your feet

cues: Take a wide stance with your toes turned out
Hold the dumbbells between your legs and keep your chest up
Push your knees out and stand by driving through your heels

movements.name: Renegade Row with Push-Up

harder_variation.name: Narrow-Stance Renegade Row with Push-Up
harder_variation.how: Bring your feet closer together so the plank has a smaller base during the rows

cues: Do one push-up with your hands on the dumbbells
Row left, then right, keeping your hips square
Count one push-up plus two rows as one rep

movements.name: Suitcase Carry
cues: Hold one heavy dumbbell at your side
Stand tall and do not lean toward or away from the weight
Walk short laps or march in place, then switch hands

movements.name: Reverse Lunge to Curl
cues: Step back into a lunge with the dumbbells at your sides
Stand up, then curl both dumbbells once
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch

movements.name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Press
cues: Kneel on one knee and hold the dumbbell at that side's shoulder
Squeeze the glute of the down leg and keep your ribs down
Press straight overhead, then switch sides

movements.name: Weighted Dead Bug

harder_variation.name: Straight-Leg Weighted Dead Bug
harder_variation.how: Lower a straight leg instead of a bent one while the dumbbell stays over your chest

cues: Hold one dumbbell with both hands straight over your chest
Press your lower back into the floor
Extend one leg at a time while the dumbbell stays still

movements.name: Tate Press
cues: Lie on the bench with the dumbbells over your chest, ends touching
Bend your elbows out to the sides to bring the dumbbells to your chest
Straighten your elbows to press back up

movements.name: Y-Raise
cues: Raise your arms up and out into a Y, thumbs up
Stop when your arms are in line with your ears
Keep your ribs down so your lower back does not arch

movements.name: DB Bent-Over Row

harder_variation.name: Deficit DB Bent-Over Row
harder_variation.how: Stand on a 2-inch step or plate and hinge until your torso is close to parallel, so each row travels farther

cues: Hinge to about 45 degrees or lower with a flat back
Row both dumbbells toward your hips
Keep your neck in line with your spine

movements.name: DB Floor Press
cues: Lie on the floor with knees bent and feet flat
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor
Press up until your arms are straight

movements.name: DB Swing

harder_variation.name: Single-Arm DB Swing
harder_variation.how: Swing the dumbbell with one hand and resist the twist; switch hands halfway

cues: Hold one dumbbell by the end with both hands
Hike it back between your legs, then snap your hips forward
Let the dumbbell float to chest height without lifting it with your arms

movements.name: Cossack Squat

harder_variation.name: Front-Rack Cossack Squat
harder_variation.how: Rack two dumbbells on your shoulders instead of holding one at your chest

cues: Take a very wide stance with your toes slightly out
Sit down over one heel while the other leg stays straight, toes up
Keep your chest up and the dumbbell at your chest

movements.name: Bicycle Crunch
cues: Rest your hands lightly behind your head with your lower back down
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee as the other leg extends
Count each side as one rep

movements.name: DB Romanian Deadlift
cues: Start standing with the dumbbells in front of your thighs
Push your hips back with soft knees until your hamstrings stretch
Keep the dumbbells close to your legs and your back flat

movements.name: Lateral Lunge
cues: Hold one dumbbell at your chest
Step wide to one side and sit back into that hip
Push off the bent leg to return to the middle

movements.name: Reverse Lunge

harder_variation.name: Deficit Reverse Lunge
harder_variation.how: Stand on a 2-inch step or plate and step back off it so the back knee travels lower

cues: Hold the dumbbells at your sides
Step back and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor
Drive through the front heel to stand

movements.name: Single-Arm Floor Press
cues: Lie on the floor with knees bent and one dumbbell at your chest
Lower until your upper arm touches the floor
Press straight up without letting your body roll

movements.name: DB Squeeze Press

harder_variation.name: Incline DB Squeeze Press
harder_variation.how: Set the bench to incline and squeeze the dumbbells together through the whole press

cues: Press the dumbbells together hard over your chest
Keep them touching as you lower to your chest
Press back up while still squeezing

movements.name: Concentration Curl
cues: Sit on the bench and brace your elbow against your inner thigh
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder
Straighten the arm fully, then switch sides after the set

movements.name: Weighted Sit-Up

harder_variation.name: Weighted Sit-Up, Arms Extended
harder_variation.how: Hold the dumbbell at arm's length over your chest for the whole sit-up instead of at your chest

cues: Hold the dumbbell at your chest with knees bent and feet flat
Sit all the way up without pulling on your neck
Lower back down until your shoulder blades touch the floor

movements.name: Bear Hold
cues: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders
Lift your knees an inch off the floor
Keep your back flat and breathe

movements.name: Plank Shoulder Taps
cues: Hold a high plank with your feet wider than your hips
Tap one hand to the opposite shoulder
Keep your hips still as you alternate

movements.name: Bird Dog
cues: Start on hands and knees with a flat back
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back
Return and switch sides without rocking your hips

movements.name: Standing DB Shoulder Press
cues: Stand tall with the dumbbells at your shoulders, palms forward
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes so your lower back does not arch
Press straight overhead until your arms are straight

movements.name: Standard Push-Up
cues: Set your hands just wider than your shoulders
Keep a straight line from heels to head
Lower until your chest is close to the floor, then push up

movements.name: Close-Grip DB Floor Press

harder_variation.name: Close-Grip DB Bench Press
harder_variation.how: Press on a flat bench instead of the floor so your elbows travel below your body on each rep

cues: Lie on the floor with knees bent and the dumbbells touching over your chest
Keep your elbows tucked close to your sides as you lower
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor, then press up

movements.name: Floor Skull Crusher
cues: Lie on the floor with knees bent and the dumbbells above your shoulders
Bend only at the elbows to bring the dumbbells beside your head
Keep your upper arms still as you straighten

movements.name: DB Floor Fly
cues: Lie on the floor with knees bent and the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing
Open your arms wide with a slight elbow bend until your upper arms touch the floor
Bring the dumbbells back together along the same arc

finishers.name: DB complex
finishers.note: Do not set the dumbbells down within a round. Rest 60 to 90 sec between rounds.

finishers.name: Bodyweight intervals
finishers.note: One movement per round in the order listed, 40 sec work and 20 sec rest. Low-impact option: fast bodyweight squats for squat jumps, march in place for fast feet.

finishers.name: Swing and carry ladder
movements: 40 sec Farmer Hold or Carry (both DBs)

finishers.name: Wall-sit burner
movements: 45 sec Wall Sit holding the DB at the chest

finishers.name: Man-makers
movements: 5 man-makers: push-up on the DBs, row left, row right, step or jump feet in, clean to shoulders, thruster
